newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech to buy some Sprint assets.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech to buy some Sprint assets.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Tuesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire certain assets of Sprint Corp's local communications business that serves a small part of the metropolitan Chicago area.

Ameritech said it will pay an undisclosed price to buy the local exchange business that serves about 136,000 residential and business access lines in a small part of northwest Chicago and parts of 10 suburban communities. The area was previously served by Centel, which became Sprint/Centel in 1993 and Sprint in July of 1996.
An undetermined number of Sprint employees will be offered the chance to apply for openings at Ameritech, the company said. The deal is expected to close in mid-1997.
Ameritech provides telecommunications services in five Midwestern states.
Its shares were off 7/8 Tuesday at 59-1/8.
